subject: Vendor portal: profile stewardship & evidence sprint kickoff
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr onboarding & evidence owner mapping (NimbusHealth)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We want to get NimbusHealth into the Vendr portal this quarter so our procurement team can complete the SIG and CAIQ review. Can your team own the initial inventory and point us to a single evidence steward?

What we need from Redwood:
- A mapped owner for each major evidence bucket (SOC2, encryption keys, logging)
- A first-pass manifest of S3/Drive locations you intend to link to the portal
- Estimated window for a bulk evidence upload (2-week sprint or smaller incremental uploads)

Target: We're aiming for vendor profile completion by 2027-05-12 to align with our procurement window. If you can confirm an ownership roster and a kickoff time this coming week that'd be great.

Attachments: none on this email (we'll share our questionnaire export shortly).

Thanks,
Jane Doe
Security Operations Manager
NimbusHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 16:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendr onboarding & evidence owner mapping (NimbusHealth)

Ben / Karthik — looping you in so we can scope and own the work for Nimbus. Jane is asking for: owner mapping, manifest, and a sprint window.

My suggested approach:
1) Ben to run a quick inventory pass and produce an "evidence_index_v1.xlsx" that maps items to Redwood stewards.
2) Karthik to validate CAIQ/SIG alignment and flag any gaps that require engineering artifacts (token logs, KMS configs).
3) Agree with Nimbus on an incremental upload cadence (we usually do a 10-business-day bulk window or 3 smaller uploads).

Can you two confirm availability next week for a 30-min kickoff and whether 2027-05-03 to 2027-05-14 works for a focused upload sprint? Jane — we prefer Vendr links + pre-signed S3 manifests; will that work on your side?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding & evidence owner mapping (NimbusHealth)

Marissa / Karthik / Jane —

Quick inventory summary attached (evidence_index_v1.xlsx) and a small S3 manifest sample (s3_manifest.csv). High-level notes:
- SOC2: latest report (2026-11) and auditor letter are in /sec/reports/soc2/2026; steward: Marissa (security partnerships).
- Encryption/KMS: key policy and rotation logs live in KMS console exports — will add a CAIQ reference in sig_caiaq_map.xlsx. Steward: Karthik (infra security).
- Logging/Monitoring: we can provide CloudWatch export slices and the Kibana snapshot; steward: Ben (platform ops).

Proposed upload cadence: incremental — two uploads. First drop (files referenced in evidence_index_v1.xlsx) on 2027-05-04; second drop (engineering logs and CAIQ crosswalk) on 2027-05-10. That keeps us ahead of the 2027-05-12 target.

Attachments included as stubs:
- evidence_index_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
- s3_manifest.csv (text/csv)
- sig_caiaq_map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Jane — can you confirm Vendr accepts presigned S3 manifests for the first drop and whether you want documents uploaded directly to the portal or linked? If direct upload is preferred we'll need portal upload credentials from your side.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jane Doe <jane.doe@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr onboarding & evidence owner mapping (NimbusHealth)

Thanks — this plan looks good. A few clarifications from the CAIQ/SIG side:

1) For CAIQ crosswalk I'll add a worksheet that flags items requiring engineering artifacts vs. policy artifacts. Expect the first-pass CAIQ flags in sig_caiaq_map.xlsx by EOD 2027-04-27 (I9ll mark critical gaps that block automated scoring).

2) Regarding log exports: we should limit first uploads to summarized slices (last 90 days) to keep portal attachments small. If Nimbus needs full retention artifacts we can provide a follow-up download link.

3) Presigned S3 is fine for the initial drop. Jane — if you can create a portal temporary upload role or share the Vendr upload endpoint we will prepare presigned URLs. Otherwise we can perform manual uploads via your portal credentials.

I'll also prepare a short checklist for Nimbus that calls out the minimum filenames and CAIQ section tags so their procurement team can validate quickly.

Next step: 30-min kickoff tomorrow (2027-04-27) at 10:00am PT — does that work for you both?

Karthik Iyer
Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference
